Experience as Residency Program Director of an American Society of Health-System Pharmacists (ASHP)-accredited program

The Pharmacy Supervisor, Education Enterprise, position serves as the PGY1 Pharmacy Residency Program Director (RPD), Acute Care Setting, and provides operational and strategic leadership for residency training while also supporting enterprise-wide standardization across pharmacy residency programs. This position is responsible for developing and implementing systems that strengthen the pharmacy workforce pipeline, promote consistent educational practices, improve learner and preceptor outcomes, and ensure alignment of education programs with departmental and organizational priorities. The supervisor collaborates with pharmacy leadership, preceptors, human resources, academic partners, and healthcare professionals to ensure educational excellence, regulatory compliance, workforce development, and achievement of departmental strategic goals.

This role devotes approximately 70% effort to direct supervision, mentoring, and performance management of residents. The remaining 30% of effort is dedicated continuous improvement, preceptor and workforce development, and community engagement initiatives.
25% - Continuous Improvement, Preceptor Development & Workforce Development
Completion of an American Society of Health-System Pharmacists (ASHP) Post Graduate Year Two (PGY2) Pharmacy Residency
